product.title: 3 Hours Private Original Venice Photo Walk

description.text: Beat the crowds and enjoy an insider's introduction to Venice during this private photo walk, which visits lesser-known neighborhoods and attractions that only locals know. Discover canals and picturesque bridges away from the tourist track, stopping to take photographs along the way. Stops include Campo San Giacomo di Rialto, Rialto Market. Tailor-made itineraries offer hands-on photography instruction. Ideal for visitors basing in Venice who want a guided city experience without coordinating vaporetto routes, attraction tickets, or landmark timing on their own. Routes stay oriented to Campo San Giacomo di Rialto, Rialto Market that define this Venice sightseeing experience, with a guide handling vaporetto connections, ticket windows, and neighborhood pacing so the day stays focused on the city rather than logistics.
